label: HPE OfficeConnect 1820 8G PoE+ 65W (J9982A)
description: 8-port gigabit smart-managed PoE+ switch: 8x 1G, 4x PoE+, 65 W PoE budget.

poe.note: HPE's own row, not the model name. The 1820 QuickSpecs (v7, 2022) J9982A Technical Specifications table prints "PoE power 65 W PoE+", with "4 RJ-45 autosensing 10/100/1000 PoE+ ports" and four further non-PoE RJ-45 ports, maximum power rating 83.9 W and idle power 12.6 W. The same document's PoE+ port availability bullet prints "Ports 1-4 provide PoE+ on the HPE 1820-8G-PoE+ (65W) switch". 65 W over four PoE+ ports is 16.25 W average, so it powers two 30 W access points, not four.

notes: Vendor figures for **J9982A**: 8 gigabit ports with **4 ports of PoE+ and a 65 W budget**. Half the ports are unpowered - a pattern that repeats across this whole range and is not obvious from the model name.
